title: Vision Transformers and the Patch-Token Primitive

questions.question: For ViT-B/16 at 224x224 with a CLS token, what does seq_length return?
options: 197: 14x14 patches plus one CLS token
196: the patch grid without any extra token
224: one token for each image row
14: one token for each patch-grid row
questions.explanation: grid_shape gives 224/16 = 14 in each direction, so there are 196 patches. seq_length adds the configured CLS token and returns 197.

questions.question: What sequence length does the Qwen2.5-VL entry in ZOO use for 896x896, patch size 14, and no registers?
options: 4096, because 64x64 patches fill the sequence
4097, because 64x64 patches are followed by one CLS token
896, because the image side is the sequence length
4160, because one position is added per patch row
questions.explanation: 896/14 = 64, giving 4096 patch tokens. The Qwen2.5-VL config keeps cls_token=True, so seq_length is 4096 + 1 = 4097.

questions.question: What does seq_length return for SigLIP SO400m/14 at 378 with four registers and cls_token=False?
options: 729, counting only the 27x27 patch grid
730, because a CLS token is always implicit
733, adding four registers to the 729 patch tokens
756, adding four registers to each grid row
questions.explanation: 378/14 = 27, so the patch grid contributes 27x27 = 729 tokens. With CLS disabled, only the four register tokens are added, for 733.

questions.question: What patch-embedding parameter count does total_params compute for ViT-B/16?
options: 589,824, omitting the projection bias
590,080, using 16x16 pixels without the RGB factor
591,360, adding a second hidden bias
590,592, from 3x16x16x768 weights plus 768 bias values
questions.explanation: patch_embed_params uses 3 * 16 * 16 * 768 + 768. The weights contribute 589,824 and the bias contributes 768, totaling 590,592.

questions.question: In patch_toy_image, how many tokens are produced from the 8x8 grayscale image with patch_size=4?
options: 4 tokens, each flattening a 4x4 patch of 16 pixels
8 tokens, one for each image row
16 tokens, one for each pixel in a patch
2 tokens, one for each grid dimension
questions.explanation: An 8x8 image split by P=4 has a 2x2 patch grid. The toy therefore emits four projected tokens, and each source patch contains 16 pixels.

questions.question: How many sequence positions does the DINOv2 ViT-g/14 config use with four registers?
options: 256, because 224/14 gives a 16x16 patch grid with no extra tokens
261, from 16x16 patches, one CLS token, and four registers
260, because the four registers replace the CLS token
265, because each register adds a full grid row
questions.explanation: For 224/14, the grid is 16x16 = 256. DINOv2 keeps one CLS token and adds four registers, so seq_length is 261.
